issue.title: [Everflow] EverflowNeighborTest test does not support egress mirroring

failure.body:
**Description**
EverflowNeighborTest test does not support egress mirroring:
```bash
TASK [test : debug] *******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
task path: /auto/mtrswgwork/nazariig/git/sysgit/bug/everflow/sonic-mgmt/ansible/roles/test/tasks/ptf_runner.yml:52
Tuesday 18 February 2020  <IPV6> +0000 (<IPV6>.272)       <IPV6>.375 ******
ok: [sonic-t1-lag] => {
    "out.stdout_lines": [
        "everflow_neighbor_test.EverflowNeighborTest ... ERROR",
        "",
        "======================================================================",
        "ERROR: everflow_neighbor_test.EverflowNeighborTest",
        "----------------------------------------------------------------------",
        "Traceback (most recent call last):",
        "  File \"acstests/everflow_neighbor_test.py\", line 195, in runTest",
        "    self.check_mirrored_packet()",
        "  File \"acstests/everflow_neighbor_test.py\", line 140, in check_mirrored_packet",
        "    payload['IP'].ttl -= 1",
        "  File \"/usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/scapy/packet.py\", line 772, in __getitem__",
        "    raise IndexError(\"Layer [%s] not found\" % lname)",
        "IndexError: Layer [IP] not found",
        "",
        "----------------------------------------------------------------------",
        "Ran 1 test in 0.004s",
        "",
        "FAILED (errors=1)"
    ]
}
Read vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'
```
The test tries to modify IP layer of ARP/NDP packet:
```python
pkt = self.basev6_pkt if ipv6 else self.base_pkt
payload = pkt.copy()

if self.mirror_stage == "egress":
    payload['Ethernet'].src = self.router_mac
    payload['IP'].ttl -= 1
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy t1-lag
2. Run Everflow test

**Describe the results you received:**
* Everflow test fails

**Describe the results you expected:**
* Everflow test should pass

resolution.title: [everflow] Deprecate ARP/ND test case
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary: Deprecates the ARP/ND mirroring test case for everflow.
Fixes #1399 (issue)

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### How did you do it?
I deleted "test case 6" from the Everflow testbed. Per the discussion in #1399 the ingress functionality we were trying to test is already covered by the `wr_arp` test case, and since we don't presently have a good use case for egress mirroring with these specific types of packets we no longer have a use for this test case.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test suite, removing the test doesn't affect the other tests.

### Documentation
